in_marathi.name: Anilkumar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Anil (wind) and Kumar (younger brother)
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anilkumar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anilkumar is a name derived from Sanskrit words 'Anil' which means wind and 'Kumar' which means younger brother. This name is often given to a younger brother born in the family during a time when the wind is blowing. In Hindu mythology, the wind god, Anil, is known to be powerful and free-willed. The name Anilkumar signifies the arrival of a new, young, and free-willed member in the family.
